name: I'd Do Anything
source:
Kylli is cursed with immortality. Messalina is cursed with an insatiable appetite. Kylli is trying to find a cure while Messalina relies on her to help assuage her hunger. 

This cycle has been going on for two years. How much longer can it go on?

[From [url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/id-do-anything]itch.io[/url]]
